title: NBA CPU-Actionable SOTA Techniques — April 2026

proposals.title: Add logistic_regression + isotonic calibration to NBA GA MODEL_TYPES
proposals.rationale: 2026 tabular SOTA (MDPI, Nature) shows logistic+CalibratedClassifierCV(isotonic) achieves Brier 0.199 on NBA — vs our current fleet best 0.22151. P7 political island uses logistic and holds POL LIVE BEST 0.24924, corroborating the technique. CPU-compatible.
proposals.implementation: In hf-space/evolution_island.py or app.py, add MODEL_TYPES entry: {'type': 'logistic_calibrated', 'model': CalibratedClassifierCV(LogisticRegression(C=1.0, max_iter=1000), method='isotonic', cv=3)}
proposals.expected_brier_gain: 0.001-0.010 if logistic proves competitive on this dataset

proposals.title: XGBoost direct Brier loss objective
proposals.rationale: arXiv 2508.02725 (Aug 2025): optimizing directly on Brier loss (squared error on probabilities) rather than binary cross-entropy consistently improves calibration and final Brier score. XGBoost supports this via objective='reg:squarederror' on probabilities.
proposals.implementation: Add MODEL_TYPES entry: {'type': 'xgboost_brier_direct', 'model': XGBClassifier(objective='reg:squarederror', ...)} alongside existing xgboost_brier model. Let GA select.

proposals.title: Stacked meta-learner ensemble
proposals.rationale: Nature Aug 2025 stacked ensemble (NaiveBayes + AdaBoost + MLP + KNN + XGBoost + LR meta-learner) outperforms all single models on NBA. With 6 CPU islands running diverse base models (ET, RF, XGB, LGB, CB, LR), a nightly stacking step on predictions could yield sub-0.220.
proposals.implementation: New script: scripts/ops/nba_stacked_ensemble.py — load top-3 island predictions for each game, fit LogisticRegression meta-learner on OOF predictions, evaluate holdout Brier.
proposals.effort: MEDIUM — new script, no Space changes needed

proposals.title: Market-implied odds as primary features
proposals.rationale: Top-3 predictor in 2026 NBA studies. We already have 249 odds categories in data/full-odds-2025-26.json. Ensure implied_prob_home, implied_prob_away, line_movement, juice features are in the top feature candidates fed to the GA.
proposals.implementation: Check features/engine.py — verify implied_probability and line_movement features exist in the feature engine. If not, add to market_efficiency category.

quick_win: P1 — logistic+isotonic in GA MODEL_TYPES. 5 lines, CPU-compatible, corroborated by P7 political live performance and 2026 MDPI paper.
